title: Reproducibility package for Four-step projective recurrence in a dyadic Cauchy-MDS shear layer
description: Exact verification code and machine-readable certificates for a dyadic Cauchy-MDS shear layer. The release directly scans all 252 admissible parameters, verifies the representative finite-field and Jordan/period data, checks the isolated AES linear reference in one row-major coordinate system, and reproduces two independent MILP computations of the exact value 25 in the stated MDS-support relaxation. The release does not claim a complete SPN cryptanalysis or a realizable AES S-box trail.
